acceptanceCriteria: A repository with more than 5000 support files makes `corvint tests example-join` refuse tests-bound-exceeded with the join's message; test added.
body: Residual from the V1-2039 review fix (PR #1317). The join lists support paths from the tree; above the 5000-entry listing budget it refuses with the older 'test files in all' message rather than the join's typed tests-bound-exceeded refusal. Expected: one typed refusal naming the join bound.
title: example-join over 5000 support files refuses with the tree-listing message instead of tests-bound-exceeded
